_comment: Reviewed company catalog. Every entry needs slug, name, domains and category. A grievance contact needs email, source_url (the company's published privacy or grievance page) and verified_on; never add an address that was not checked against its source. Fictional entries use @example.com, carry fictional: true and are loaded outside production only. Personal additions go in catalog.local.json (not committed).
